paragraph: She didn't even try to do the right **thing**. There is another **thing** that you need to do. I just have one other **thing** to do.
english: that which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept
arabicDesc: مثال: لم تحاول حتى ان تفعل الشيء الصحيح.

paragraph: I have said that to you **because** I love you. Did you keep her picture **because** you still love her? I broke down the door **because** I lost the key.
english: by or for the cause that; on this account that; for the reason that
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد قلت لك هذا لأنّني أحبّك.

paragraph: I don't want to talk about this **right** now. I can't come up with a plan **right** now. You have no **right** to stop at this street.
english: legal or moral entitlement — see also entitlement, privilege, prerogative
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريد أن أتحدث بشأن هذا الآن.

paragraph: No **state** has the right to exist. They live in the same **state**. He's in a bad **state**.
english: a political division of a federation retaining a degree of autonomy
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس لأي دولة الحق في الوجود.

other.meaning: To declare to be a fact (verb)

paragraph: I don't know if **most** girls are like this. What's the **most** important part of a good education? What he needs **most** is a good job.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعلم إن كانت غالبية الفتيات هكذا ام لا.

paragraph: I can't tell you how **much** I love you. I would like to know how **much** it costs. There is not **much** **more** that police can do.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكنني أن أخبرك كم أحبّك.

paragraph: I remember hearing a **very** similar story to that. Children are often **very** good at learning foreign languages. You're **very** good at doing that, aren't you?
arabicDesc: مثال: أذكر أني سمعت قصة مشابهة.

paragraph: I need you to tell me **where** to go. It was **where** you told me it would be. Now I can see **where** my real friends are.
english: at what place; to what place; from what place
arabicDesc: مثال: أحتاج لتقول لي أين أذهب.

paragraph: He was really the **man** we were looking for. He talks as if he were an old **man**. What kind of woman could love such a **man**?
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد كان فعلاً الرجل الذي كنا نبحث عنه.

other.meaning: To supply (something) with staff or crew (of either sex) (verb)

paragraph: **Even** your mother doesn't know who your father is. I'm not **even** sure if this is my key. I'm going there **even** if you don't go.
arabicDesc: مثال: حتى أمك لا تعلم من هو أبوك.

paragraph: Maybe you **should** take a look at this again. You **should** focus on the road when you drive. You **should** read such books as will benefit you.
arabicDesc: مثال: ربّما عليك أن تلقي نظرة أخرى على هذا.

paragraph: Why are you doing this, if I **may** ask? The month of **May** is the month of mothers. You **may** take either of the two books.
english: fifth month of the Gregorian calendar
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تفعل هذا إن كان لي أن أسأل؟

paragraph: This is the first time that I've been **here**. I want to know what's going on out **here**. If you have any questions, I'm **here** to help.
english: in, on, or at this place
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه المرة الأولى أكون هنا

paragraph: Do you **really** want to talk about that now? No one **really** seemed to know who lived there. Not **really**... It's got nothing to do with you.
english: in a way or manner that is real, not unreal
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنتِ تريد حقاً التحدث بشأن هذا الأن؟

other.meaning: Indicating surprise at, or requesting confirmation of, some new information (interjection)

paragraph: You are the **great** love of my life. What a **great** time we have had. I thought it was a **great** idea.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت حب حياتي.

paragraph: Can I be one of your new friends, **too**? I think this table takes up **too** much space. This book is **too** difficult for me to understand.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكاني أن أصبح واحدا من أصدقائك الجدد أيضا؟

paragraph: I'm at work now, so I'll **call** you later. Please **call** me up if you want me. If you're looking for a job, **call** me.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا في العمل الأن, لذلك سأتصل بكَ لاحقاً.

paragraph: Some children **play** video games all the time. This is food. You don't **play** with it. Kids, please **play** away from my home.
arabicDesc: مثال: بعض الأطفال يلعبون ألعاب الفيديو في كل الأوقات.

other.meaning: 7.8. to act or perform (a play) — see also act
(transitive) produce music using a musical instrument
Activity for amusement only, especially among the young (noun)

paragraph: I want to **show** you something in my office. She needs us to **show** her the way. Come and I'll **show** you who I am.
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أريك شيئا في مكتبي.

other.meaning: to indicate (a fact) to be true
A play, dance, or other entertainment (noun)

paragraph: I've told you **before** that I don't like that. All that has happened **before**, and will happen again. I had never seen such a beautiful girl **before**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد أخبرتك مسبقا أننى لا أحب هذا

paragraph: I'm getting **off** the train at the next stop. Please don't take my mind **off** the work. You should turn **off** the light before going to sleep.
english: away from a place or surface; also not working or turned off
arabicDesc: مثال: سأنزل من القطار عند المحطة القادمة.

paragraph: I know **why** you don't want to do that. **Why** do you think you have to do that? **Why** do you think I told her about it?
arabicDesc: مثال: أعلم لماذا لا تريد القيام بذلك.

paragraph: Could you please tell me why you **love** her? I decided to tell her that I **love** her. I know you're not in **love** with me.
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك إخباري عن سبب حبك لها؟

other.meaning: object of one's romantic feelings; darling or sweetheart
To have a strong affection for (someone or something) (verb)

paragraph: You could **still** do that in a nicer way. I **still** have feelings for her to this day. Do you think she **still** thinks about me?
english: up to a time, as in the preceding time
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكانك فعل ذلك بطريقة ألطف.

paragraph: I'll **tell** you what I want you to do. I don't know what I'm going to **tell** them. Talk to him and **tell** him to come back.
arabicDesc: مثال: سأخبرك بما أريد فعله.

other.meaning: A hill or mound, originally and especially in the Middle East, over or consisting of the ruins of ancient settlements (noun)

paragraph: Have you heard about the result of the **game**? Do you know who won the last **game**? The rules of the **game** have changed.
english: playful activity that may be unstructured, amusement, pastime
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سمعت عن نتيجة المباراة؟

paragraph: I have only half as **many** books as he. There are **many** people and cars on that street. I didn't expect so **many** people to be here.
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس عندي إلا نصف عدد كتبه.

other.meaning: A large, indefinite number of people or things (pronoun)

paragraph: I'll **never** forget the first time I saw you. **Never** in my life have I heard such a thing. They have **never** even heard of the US.
arabicDesc: مثال: لن أنس أبدا المرّة الأولى التي رأيتك فيها.

paragraph: As **long** as we live, we have to work. I have been waiting here for a **long** time. I didn't know how **long** the meeting would last.
english: having much distance from one point to another
arabicDesc: مثال: طالما أننا نعيش، علينا أن نعمل.

paragraph: These are my books, and **those** are his books. Who was the one who issued **those** orders? **Those** people didn't tell us anything about you.
english: used to point to people or things farther away; plural of that
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه كتبي، وتلك كتبه.

paragraph: People are living in all parts of the **world**. When will the **world** come to an end? People should understand that the **world** is changing.
arabicDesc: مثال: الناس يعيشون في جميع أنحاء العالم.

paragraph: You should **start** as early as you can. To **start** with, I must thank you for your help. Tell me the whole story and **start** from the beginning.
arabicDesc: مثال: ينبغي أن تبدأَ أبكر ما يمكنك.

paragraph: All you have to do is **try** your best. I don't think I can, but I'll **try**. I'll **try** not to be away too long.
arabicDesc: مثال: كل ما عليك فعله هو بذل جهدك.

paragraph: I am in the first year of **high** school. He started going to a new **high** school. He paid too **high** a price for success.
arabicDesc: مثال: انا في السنة الأولى من التعليم الثانوي.

paragraph: **Life** at this college is nothing like I expected. This is my **life** and this is who I am. I think **life** is what you make it.
arabicDesc: مثال: الحياة في هذه الكلية ليست كما توقعت البتة.

paragraph: Please write **down** what I am going to say. The car broke **down**, so they had to walk. I need to give her time to cool **down**.
arabicDesc: مثال: من فضلك اكتب ما سأقوله.

other.meaning: Soft, fluffy immature feathers which grow on young birds. Used as insulating material in duvets, sleeping bags and jackets (noun)

paragraph: I want to **live** at home with my family. I don't think that I can **live** without you. Where do the people who speak your language **live**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أعيش في البيت مع أسرتي.

paragraph: This is the **last** time I let you go. I can't remember the **last** time I used them. When was the **last** time you sold a car?
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه آخر مرة أتركك تذهب فيها.

paragraph: Do you want me to **help** you do that? I'm not sure I can be of any **help**. I wish that I could do more to **help**.
english: to provide assistance to (someone or something)
arabicDesc: مثال: أتريد مني مساعدتك في ذلك؟

other.meaning: A cry of distress or an urgent request for assistance (interjection)

paragraph: Let's go outside and talk this **through**. Who can fit their car **through** there? If you do this, we're **through**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لنخرج و نناقش الأمر.

other.meaning: from one side of an opening to the other

paragraph: Would you take **part** in this event? He has a **part** in that movie. A **part** of this land is mine.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تشارك في هذا الحدث؟

other.meaning: position or role, especially in a play
To leave the company of (each other, or someone/something [with with or from]) (verb)

paragraph: After a **while**, the man came into the room. Now you be good **while** I'm gone, do you hear? You're working too hard. Take it easy for a **while**.
english: uncertain duration of time, a period of time
arabicDesc: مثال: بعد لحظة، دخل الرجل الى الغرفة.

paragraph: I'm going to find a **place** of my own. You better decide if it's the **place** for you. Why are you sleeping in a **place** like this?
arabicDesc: مثال: ساعثر علي مكان خاص بي.

other.meaning: area one occupies, particularly for sitting

paragraph: We had better go **home** rather than wait here. At what time did you arrive at your **home**? Are you always at **home** in the evening?
english: house or structure in which someone lives — see also domicile, dwelling, abode
arabicDesc: مثال: من الأفضل أن نعود إلى البيت بدلا من الانتظار هنا.

paragraph: We heard it from Mr **Such** and **such**. I've never heard of **such** a story before. We all had **such** a good time.
english: used to make a comparison with something implied by context
arabicDesc: مثال: سمعنا ذلك من فلان و فلان.

paragraph: Did you **include** everything you wanted to say in the text? I love you so much, **including** today. What activities would you **include** in your perfect date?
english: to contain, as part of a whole
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تضمّنت كل ما أردت أن تقوله في النصّ؟

paragraph: How would you **feel** if your wife left you? If you have any questions, **feel** free to ask us. She began to get the **feel** of her new office.
english: to use or experience the sense of touch
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف ستشعر اذا تركتك زوجتك ؟

paragraph: If you **keep** trying, you'll get better at it. If you want to **keep** your job, do this. **Keep** a record of how much you spend.
arabicDesc: مثال: واصِل المحاولة وستصبح أفضل.

paragraph: I like to talk about the good **old** days. He has a new car and an **old** car. She helped an **old** woman across the street.
english: of an object, concept, relationship, etc., having existed for a relatively long period of time
arabicDesc: مثال: أود الحديث عن الأيام الجميلة الماضية.

paragraph: You have to **change** trains at the next stop. We tried to get him to **change** his mind, but couldn't. I'm going to **change** all that.
english: to make something into something else
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تركب قطاراً آخر عند المحطة القادمة.

other.meaning: The process or result of becoming different (noun)

paragraph: Why would you want to do **something** like that? Isn't there **something** you want to say to me? We have to do **something** about what's going on.
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تريد أن تفعل شيئا من هذا القبيل؟

paragraph: The students don't have to go to **school** today. I'm in the first year of high **school**. I'm not going to go to **school** today.
english: an institution dedicated to teaching and learning
arabicDesc: مثال: الطلبة لن يذهبوا إلى المدرسة اليوم.

other.meaning: a department/institute at a college or university

paragraph: If I were you, I would also do the **same**. She looks exactly the **same** as she was at school. I can't say the **same** about you.
english: not different as regards self; identical
arabicDesc: مثال: لو كنتُ مكانك, كنتُ سأفعل نفس الشئ؟

paragraph: Everyone must learn on their **own** in the end. Every man has a right to his **own** property. Do you think he did the job on his **own**?
arabicDesc: مثال: في النهاية، على الجميع أن يتعلموا بأنفسهم.

other.meaning: To have rightful possession of (property, goods or capital) (verb)

paragraph: There are only two ways out of this **house**. What time did you leave your **house** this morning? Her father left her the **house** in his will.
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك سبيلين فقط للخروج من هذا المنزل.

paragraph: You must not **run** in the school buildings. Can I **run** a few ideas past you? Why did she **run** away from me?
english: to move quickly on two feet
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك ألّا تركض داخل مبنى المدرسة.

paragraph: Trust yourself and follow your heart to the **end**. I stood at the **end** of the line. It's not the **end** of the world.
arabicDesc: مثال: ثق بنفسك واتبع قلبك حتي النهاية.

paragraph: **Both** of the students passed all their tests. **Both** of those students didn't pass the test. **Both** of them are in the room.
english: each of two; one and the other
arabicDesc: مثال: كلا الطالبين حضرا جميع الامتحانات.

paragraph: I was with you **every** step of the way. **Every** time I go out, I forget something. Always! I see you in **every** one of my dreams.
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد كنت معك في كل خطوة على الطريق.

paragraph: When we're children, everything around us looks so **big**. The store was not a **big** one, was it? This box is not as **big** as that one.
arabicDesc: مثال: عندما كنا أطفالا، كل ما حولنا بدا كبيرا.

paragraph: He is older than she is by **three** years. He makes **three** times more money than I do. The **three** countries were united to make one country.
arabicDesc: مثال: هو أكبر منها سنا بثلاث سنوات.

paragraph: This is a man, that is a **woman**. The **woman** I saw there wasn't the **woman** I knew. That **woman** is much older than I am.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا رجل، تلك امرأة.

paragraph: You'll have a lot to do now that I'm **around**. A lot of students **around** the world are studying English. You shouldn't say that kind of thing when children are **around**.
english: forming a circle or closed curve containing
arabicDesc: مثال: سيكون لديك الكثير من العمل بما أنني هنا.

paragraph: I do not know what is going on **between** them. What is the difference **between** this and that? I can't explain the difference **between** those two.
english: in the position or interval that separates two things
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعلم ما يجري بينهنما.

paragraph: She came up to me and asked my **name**. I can't think of his **name** just now. I asked him if he knew my **name**.
english: word or phrase indicating a particular person, place, class or thing
arabicDesc: مثال: أتتني وسألتني عن اسمي.

other.meaning: reputation — see also reputation, fame, renown

paragraph: I finished the work in **less** than an hour. I understand this, more or **less**. Society could not care **less**.
english: to a smaller extent or degree
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد أنهيت العمل في أقل من ساعة

paragraph: I'll **always** remember the first time I saw her. This is **always** the way it has been. I will **always** love you no matter what you do.
arabicDesc: مثال: سأتذكر دائما أول مرة رأيتها فيها.

paragraph: He is the greatest player the **team** has had. She wants to come back to the **team**. She has been chosen to lead the **team**.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه أروع لاعب امتلكه الفريق!

paragraph: Any chance you know where I **put** my keys? I don't remember exactly where I **put** the keys. **Put** the keys on the table and get out.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعلم أين وضعتُ مفاتيحي؟

paragraph: Do you have one a **little** bigger than these? You can stay a **little** longer if you want. I'm going to stay just a **little** bit longer.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل عندك واحد أكبر قليلًا من هذه؟

other.meaning: Not much, only a little: only a small amount (of) (determiner)

paragraph: I've been waiting for him **since** early this morning. He changed a lot **since** the last time. **Since** that day, they have become very close.
arabicDesc: مثال: انا انتظره منذ هذا الصباح الباكر.

paragraph: The stock reached its high **point** last July. You have a **point** there. He **pointed** out that the plan would cost a lot of money.
arabicDesc: مثال: وصلت أسعار الأسهم ذروتها في يوليو الماضي.

other.meaning: To extend the index finger in the direction of something in order to show where it is or to draw attention to it (verb)

paragraph: I don't want to hear **another** word about it! We can talk about this **another** time if you want. I don't really care one way or **another**.
english: one more, in addition to a former number
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أُريد أن أسمع كلمة أُخرىَ عن هذا!

paragraph: Can you tell us more about your **company**? He told me that he wanted to leave the **company**. This **company** doesn't even have a meeting room.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكانك أن تزوّدنا بمزيد من المعلومات عن شركتك؟

paragraph: This time, we'll **win** the football cup. We aren't going to **win**. How much did you **win**?
english: to reach some destination or object, despite difficulty or toil (now usually intransitive, with preposition or locative adverb)
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه المرّة سنفوز بكأس كرة القدم.

paragraph: I worked hard in order to support my **family**. I'm looking forward to spending time with my **family**. He works hard to support his large **family**.
english: immediate family [as a group], e.g. parents and their children
arabicDesc: مثال: عملت عملا شاقا لكي أدعم عائلتي.

other.meaning: group of people related by blood, marriage, law, or custom
rank in a taxonomic classification, above both genus and species

paragraph: That's what I wanted to **talk** to you about. I have no more time to **talk** with you. Go away. I don't want to **talk** to you.
arabicDesc: مثال: أردت الحديث معك عن هذا الأمر.

paragraph: I have a question I need to **ask** you. I have come to **ask** you for your opinion. Let's **ask** her when she gets back home.
arabicDesc: مثال: لدي سؤال أريد سؤالك عنه.

paragraph: My father and mother were sitting **under** a tree. I don't want to work **under** these conditions. I see a girl standing **under** that tree.
arabicDesc: مثال: كان أبي وأمي جالسين تحت شجرةٍ.

paragraph: **During** the day, the area was beautiful. Do you have any free time **during** the week? My friends stood by me **during** the court case.
english: for all of a given time interval
arabicDesc: مثال: في النهار، كان المكان جميلا.

paragraph: I know that you want to **become** a doctor. Her daughter has **become** a beautiful woman. My dream is to **become** a teacher.
arabicDesc: مثال: أعلم أنّك تريد أن تصبح طبيبا.

paragraph: It was just someone who had the wrong **number**. Could you please give me the **number** for the police? The police were able to track the **number**.
english: used to show the rank of something in a list or sequence
arabicDesc: مثال: كان مجرد شخص اتصل بالرقم الخطأ.

other.meaning: abstract entity used to describe quantity

paragraph: How many days are there in a **week**? She went to the market once a **week**. How much money did you spend last **week**?
arabicDesc: مثال: كم عدد الأيام في الأسبوع؟

paragraph: Costs of financial **services** are rising in every country. The number you have called is not in **service**. What does it take to get some **service** here?
arabicDesc: مثال: تكاليف الخدمات المالية آخذة في الارتفاع في كل بلد.

paragraph: Thank you for adding me to the **group**. I'm the only one in this **group** who doesn't speak French. Do you have something to do with this **group**?
english: number of things or persons being in some relation to each other
arabicDesc: مثال: شكرا لإضافتي للمجموعة.

paragraph: I don't like that **guy**. Stop going out with him. I have the feeling that I've met that **guy** before. Are you the **guy** who lives here?
english: an effigy of a man burned on a bonfire on the anniversary of the Gunpowder Plot (5th November)
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يعجبني هذا الشخص, توقّف عن الخروج معه.

paragraph: He is my **friend**. Do you guys know him? I called my **friend** after arriving at the station. Would you like to be my new **friend**?
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه صديقي، هل تعرفونه يا شباب؟

paragraph: Lack of sleep is **bad** for your health. I knew that something **bad** might happen. I had a **bad** dream last night.
english: not good; of low quality or unpleasant
arabicDesc: مثال: قلة النوم مضر بصحتك.

paragraph: If I'm late **again**, I'm going to be fired. Do I have to do it over **again**? I just wanted to talk to you **again**.
arabicDesc: مثال: إن تأخرت مجددا، فسأطرد.

paragraph: We went to see him the **next** day. We don't know where we'll live **next** year. His new book is going to come out **next** month.
english: nearest date, time, space or order
arabicDesc: مثال: ذهبنا لرؤيته في اليوم التّالي.

paragraph: I did say that, but I didn't **mean** it. Do you **mean** you don't know what happened? I really didn't **mean** for this to happen.
arabicDesc: مثال: صحيح قلت هذا، لكني لم أقصده.

other.meaning: A method or course of action used to achieve some result (noun)

paragraph: Football was played in China in the **second** century. It's the **second**-highest in the world. Wait for me, wait a **second**!
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت كرة القدم تُلعَبُ في الصين في القرن الثاني.

other.meaning: A unit of angle equal to one-sixtieth of a minute of arc or one part in 3600 of a degree (noun)

paragraph: At least let me help **set** the table. As soon as their meeting was over, they **set** to work. I'll **set** out for China next week.
arabicDesc: مثال: على الأقل دعني أساعد في ترتيب الطاولة.

other.meaning: A young plant fit for setting out (noun)
An ancient Egyptian god, variously described as the god of chaos, the god of thunder and storms, or the god of destruction (noun)

paragraph: Can you explain to me who this **child** is? Don't treat me as if I were a **child**. I don't want to talk about my **child**.
english: a person who has not yet reached adulthood, whether natural (puberty), cultural (initiation), or legal (majority)
arabicDesc: مثال: من أين لك هذا الولد؟

paragraph: How did you come to know **each** other? **Each** text should be of a different type. I thought you two knew **each** other.
english: every one of two or more, considered separately
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف تعرفتما إلى بعضكما؟

paragraph: **Mr** Green, you are wanted on the phone. **Mr** Brown came to see you were out. **Mr** Brown gave me your name.
english: a title used before a man's family name
arabicDesc: مثال: سيد غرين، أنت مطلوب على الهاتف.

paragraph: **Without** him nothing was made that has been made. I couldn't have done it **without** you. Thank you. I don't think I can live **without** you.
arabicDesc: مثال: بغيره لم يكن شيء مما كان.

paragraph: No. I don't know. It's a **lot** of things. He makes a **lot** more money than I do. There were a **lot** of people in the room.
english: a nephew of Abraham in the Bible and Quran
arabicDesc: مثال: لا، لا أعلم. هناك أشياء كثيرة.

paragraph: It's a **system** that works. It's part of the **system**. It's not a perfect **system**.
english: group or set of related things that operate together as a complex whole
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه نظامٌ يعمل.

paragraph: If you're not with us then you're **against** us. I decided to take his side **against** the others. Anything you say can and will be used **against** you.
arabicDesc: مثال: إذا لم تكن معنا فأنت ضدنا.
